text:
ana torres: Drafting a tiny pattern doc: compact sidebar groups + stable deep links. Quick idea: group Models + Endpoints into a single parent tile with disclosure chevron; child routes keep full canonical URLs. Prototype: https://sketch.redwood/compact-ia-v2

jun park: love it. key constraints: 1) legacy links must still resolve; 2) preserve query/hash; 3) avoid unexpected focus traps on deep link open.

elaine wu: wording nits: parent tile label should be sentence case, e.g., 'Serving and endpoints'. Collapse button aria-label -> 'Hide navigation' when hiding entire sidebar, but for the group chevron use 'Expand Serving and endpoints'. Keep tooltip copy short.

mike cole: technical plan: router shim that maps legacy paths to canonical ones and uses history.replaceState for client-side visits. Will add X-Orig-Path header on server redirects and emit telemetry event nav_route_rewrite. Example snippet: 
```
// pseudo
if (legacyMap[path]) {
  target = legacyMap[path]
  res.redirect(301, `${target}${req.url.search}${req.url.hash}`)
}
```

samir (sam): accessibility checklist: set aria-expanded on disclosure; aria-controls to the child list; announce breadcrumb changes with aria-live='polite'. If deep link opens a side panel, move focus to the panel heading and provide a visible 'Close' to return focus.

priya rao: docs note: we'll maintain a migration table for public links and add a short release blurb so external users don't panic. I'll coordinate once Mike files the infra ticket.

ana torres: tiny UX ask: when arriving from external source show a slim pill 'From docs' that can be dismissed; don't auto-open long panels. Makes keyboard flows predictable.

jun park: final acceptance: legacy permalinks resolve (preserve search+hash), group label copy reviewed, aria attributes implemented, breadcrumb live region in place. I'll update the prototype and share frames. :thumbsup:
